summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin module is a web page for administering staff data in HSPnet. It uses ASP.NET Web Forms with various controls like Panels, Labels, DropDownLists, TextBoxes, Validators, and a GridView to present and manage staff employment applications. The page dynamically loads JavaScript files and initializes various UI components on page load. It provides filtering options based on site and discipline and displays a list of employment applications.
purpose: The purpose of the WelcomeStaffAdmin is to provide a web interface for managing staff employment applications, facilitating filtering and viewing of applications based on specific criteria such as site and discipline.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.purpose: To input the start date for filtering applications.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.purpose: To input the end date for filtering applications.

fields.name: ddSite
fields.purpose: To select the site for filtering applications.

fields.name: ddDiscipline
fields.purpose: To select the discipline for filtering applications.

fields.name: chkShowWithdrawn
fields.purpose: To include withdrawn applications in the view.

fields.name: gvwApplications
fields.purpose: To display a list of employment applications.

workflows.name: Filter and View Applications
steps: Check or uncheck chkShowWithdrawn to include or exclude withdrawn applications.
Click cmdRefreshView to refresh the application data in gvwApplications.

business_rules: Default date range is set to the last 3 months on initial page load.
The end date should not be before the start date.

validations.message: End date must be after start date.

conditions: If SiteID is provided in the query string, pre-select it in the ddSite dropdown.
system_behavior: Populates site and discipline dropdowns on page load.
Uses AJAX for asynchronous update of the applications grid.
JavaScript is used to validate date ranges on the client side.
dependencies: Various ASP.NET controls and AjaxControlToolkit for UI functionality.
HSPnet.DataLayer for accessing employment application data.
